messages.subject: Re: error in BSM
parts:
Hi -- I got BSM to work directly after running the basic BioGeoBEARS example ML script.  However, the BSM script that is online requires a few modifications to use after the example ML script, because the original BSM example was time-stratified, and the basic BioGeoBEARS example script is non-time-stratified.

To make this simpler for everyone, I've pasted the run-BSM-directly-after-the-basic-BioGeoBEARS-ML-example script, here:

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeographical-stochastic-mapping-example-script#BSM_script_plain

So, try that, after running the ML example script here:

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#script

Cheers!
Nick

Error in stochastic_map_branch(): Stochastic mapping failed after maxtries=40000 tries on branch below node=13

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: error in BSM
parts:
Hi -- I got it to run on DEC+J+w at least, which is what I got as the best-fit model among the +w models. 

Re: optimization, I noticed optimization problems with the default optimizer of BioGeoBEARS_run_object$use_optimx = TRUE.  A better one for complex problems is BioGeoBEARS_run_object$use_optimx="GenSA" (Generalized Simulated Annealing). With that, I got DEC+J+w as the best model, and also BSM worked fine, see attached.

Note: There is some error in the plotting script for plotting BSMs with a tree-with-fossils like you have here. You can see one painted branch is misplaced.  I don't have time to try and fix the script, but the PDF could easily be manually fixed in e.g. Adobe Illustrator or the free Inkscape.

Cheers!
Nick

2018-01-17 23:54 GMT-02:00 Nick Matzke <nickmat...@gmail.com>:
Hi -- I got it to run on DEC+J+w at least, which is what I got as the best-fit model among the +w models. 

Re: optimization, I noticed optimization problems with the default optimizer of BioGeoBEARS_run_object$use_optimx = TRUE.  A better one for complex problems is BioGeoBEARS_run_object$use_optimx="GenSA" (Generalized Simulated Annealing). With that, I got DEC+J+w as the best model, and also BSM worked fine, see attached.

Note: There is some error in the plotting script for plotting BSMs with a tree-with-fossils like you have here. You can see one painted branch is misplaced.  I don't have time to try and fix the script, but the PDF could easily be manually fixed in e.g. Adobe Illustrator or the free Inkscape.

Cheers!
Nick
